title: Armory: Core Loop
summary: Build, test, repair, and refine loadouts around the dangers you actually meet.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Salvage parts, craft gear, test stance behavior, install modules, then use feedback from failed routes to refine the loadout rather than blindly climbing tiers.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each route, check what failed first: damage type, reach, stamina, shield timing, or spare parts. Upgrade the weak point instead of replacing the whole kit.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Return while the armor can still take a mistake. A spare blade, shield, and repair window matter more than one extra fight.

blocks.title: Loop Anchor
blocks.body: Treat this as a material checkpoint: if it helps the loop, bring it home before chasing bulk.
